name: forex-predictor-monorepo

scripts.dev:api: cd api && conda run --no-capture-output -n forex_prediction uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.start:api: cd api && conda run --no-capture-output -n forex_prediction uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000

_notes: Do NOT pass --workers to uvicorn. The realtime relay must run in a single uvicorn worker; multi-worker support is out of scope (see openspec/changes/realtime-websocket-relay/design.md).
